method: Integrated column mass above 55 km from a standard Venus atmosphere model. The uncertainty is the model, not the integration. Rounded: rounded from 574: a ±25 bar owns the tens digit.
used_for: The claim that radiation is not the problem on the deck.
wrong_if: The atmosphere model is wrong above 55 km, which it may be — the density profile there is less well constrained than lower down, and a systematic error would move all of it one way.
